thought.text: Das ist ein fundamentales Architekturproblem! Lass mich sehen ob WorldTick intern die Dependencies erstellen kann:

reasoning_content:
The core issue is that WorldTick constructor needs ~20 parameters but ServerBootstrap only passes ws. This is a fundamental architecture problem.

Options:
1. Make WorldTick use lazy initialization / singletons internally
2. Make ServerBootstrap create all dependencies first (big refactor) 
3. Use environment-based singleton pattern

Let me check if there's a simpler fix - can WorldTick create what it needs internally? Let me look at what interfaces are needed and check lazy pattern.
